findings: Verified: controller_command now invokes /usr/sbin/runuser by absolute path, removing the parent-side PATH=/usr/bin:/bin dependency that caused the incident; child transport is unchanged (env -i with only PATH, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, PYTHONPATH; absolute /usr/bin/python3 -B; fixed module and installed config; operation as tail argument). No PATH broadening, user change, sudo grant, or job start.

Verified: fail-closed boundaries around the exec are untouched — root-only invocation, operation whitelist (status/controls), controller_uid must resolve to the research-controller account via pwd, checked_source pins the source root before execution, and stdout is bounded at 100000 bytes.

Verified: recovery semantics preserved — TimeoutExpired/CalledProcessError still map to CONTROL_TRANSPORT_PENDING_CHECK_STATUS_NO_BLIND_RETRY; a missing /usr/sbin/runuser now fails loudly as FileNotFoundError instead of a masked pending state; the durably written root-owned request file plus control_delivery deduplication means a transport crash neither loses nor double-applies a control.

Verified: no scientific-approval surface is touched — admission, publication, notification, packet identity digest (source/packet/report), report immutability, and all separately gated scientific paths are unchanged, so prior approvals for unchanged source remain applicable.

Suggestion: the regression test pins the exact executable, the scrubbed-PATH string, and the operation position, but does not assert the env -i scrub or -u research-controller (the repair note's 'scrubbed child environment' claim is only partially enforced), and its subprocess fixture ignores check=True/timeout kwargs; asserting the full argv prefix would pin the whole transport.

Suggestion: env itself is still resolved via the parent's PATH by runuser (works because /usr/bin is inside the scrubbed PATH); using absolute /usr/bin/env would eliminate the last PATH-dependent resolution in this transport.

Observation (pre-existing, non-blocking): the child always reads the hardcoded /etc/research-system/handover-controller.json while parent-side identity/source checks validate the caller-supplied --config; no privilege impact since invocation is root-only and the child config must pass the root-owned configuration() check, but a parity assertion between the two config paths would prevent divergence confusion.

investigator_disposition.actual_verification: Reviewed correction installed; real human status/pause/repeat/resume/invalid input passed, followed by one idle non-root service tick. No new model calls or jobs. See hosted-final-handover-20260907.
investigator_disposition.remaining_suggestions: The fixed /usr/bin:/bin includes env, and the installed config is the hardcoded config. No new privilege or PATH broadening is needed. Preserve suggestions as maintenance notes, not new approval gates.
